result:
That was the first poll (armed against the pre-amend head) finally exiting — no new information; the final head `9428d3ab00` is green on all three checks and PR #167 is ready.

Nothing further from me on this lane. One note on what I deliberately did not do: I applied the `harness` label but left `fold-ready` alone — that label means the board has audited the PR, and it isn't a lane's to grant itself. So #167 waits on a board tick to be picked up, and once it folds, the `selftest` check goes green on master and #152 and #155 can fold behind it.
